Hook payloads in `claude-code-hooks.json` are copied from tuios
`internal/integration/testdata/hooks/claude-code.json` (MIT, Copyright Gaurav
Gosain and contributors), which were captured from Claude Code 2.1.286/2.1.296.
`transcripts/` holds a fixture subagent transcript in Claude Code's layout
(`<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl`), used by the agent story.
